raw_text: Chinese satellite tracking vessel Yuan Wang 5 has been detected operating within India's exclusive economic zone near the Andaman and Nicobar archipelago. The 25,000-tonne vessel, which serves dual-use space tracking and signals intelligence roles, entered the area without diplomatic clearance. The Indian Navy's Eastern Naval Command has deployed assets to maintain surveillance. Yuan Wang 5 previously operated in the Sri Lanka-adjacent Indian Ocean in August 2022, causing significant diplomatic friction.
